title: Dedup: Pick the Structure

tests.name: order-preserving dedup
tests.hint: HashSet<string> seen + List result — O(n), order intact.

tests.name: sorted set intersection
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(string.Join(",", Solution.Common(new[] { 4, 1, 2, 2 }, new[] { 2, 4, 4, 9 })), "2,4", "intersection, sorted, no dups");
Cj.Eq(Solution.Common(new[] { 1 }, new[] { 2 }).Count, 0, "disjoint");
tests.hint: HashSet b, filter a where seen-in-b, then OrderBy + Distinct — or rely on set IntersectWith then sort.
